# Tasks: lane-autonomy
<!-- Generated by /hef.tasks -->
<!-- Date: 2026-11-03 -->

Every task is test-first: the test cites its FR/NR id, fails first, then passes. Every guard and policy input gets a
mutant that turns the suite red (constitution 3). New tests go in `tests/smoke-autonomy.sh` (part 8) unless a task
names another file. Plan references: `R<n> #<m>` = plan.md Revision n, item m; `R7` = "Carried into tasks".

## Phase 3: User Stories (by priority)

### P1 — Must Have

**Launcher facts (US4, NR-007)**

- [ ] T011 [FR-006] [NR-002] The launcher pins `verified_head` = `git -C "$TOP" rev-parse refs/heads/<branch>` at
  verify launch/`--prepare` through `record --verified-head`; at transcription it refuses when the head moved, stamps
  each verdict with `verdict --head <sha>`, writes `record --required-gates` (the verify chain + the kind gate;
  `/hef.verify` whenever `spec_dir` is set, whatever the route — R3 #6) and records FAIL for every required gate missing
  from the report (R3 #3). Tests: head moved → refused; omitted gate → FAIL recorded. `hooks/session-launch.sh`
- [ ] T012 [FR-006] Verify workers launch with `--setting-sources user` (R3 #5). Tool-call test:
  `session-launch.sh verify <id> --dry-run` shows it, the implement line does not; the live sandbox check still passes
  (`--settings` still applies). `hooks/session-launch.sh`
- [ ] T013 [NR-007] Pin the base: at worktree creation the launcher records `record --base-sha <sha>` — in run mode
  before `claude -w`, from `$TOP`'s HEAD after the `GIT_FETCH_SAFE` fetch; an existing worktree with no `base_sha`
  refuses with `human:intake`, never passes. Test with one real `-w` in the fixture: the pin equals the created
  worktree's merge-base. `hooks/session-launch.sh`
- [ ] T014 [NR-007] **Test-first, R7 must #1 — the reference set.** Write the failing tests before T015: a sensitive
  file passes when it byte-equals its version at the pinned base **or** at the freshly fetched `origin/<integration>`
  (read from `$TOP` after the fetch); additions and deletions judged against the same two trees; mutant: a file equal
  to neither refuses. Without this every merge-in of a base whose `.claude/` changed would ask. `tests/smoke-autonomy.sh`
- [ ] T015 [NR-007] The sensitive-set guard (R5 #1, R6, R7), in `ledger-autonomy.sh` (split into
  `hooks/config-guard.sh` if the file nears 500 code lines), called with one line before **every launch into an
  existing worktree** — implement, verify and deploy, run mode and `--prepare`:
  - two-directional set from `git -C "$TOP" ls-tree -r` of the reference trees (T014): the `.claude` entry,
    `.claude/**` (rules included), every `CLAUDE.md`/`CLAUDE.local.md`, `.mcp.json`, `@`-imports of every base
    `CLAUDE.md` to depth 5 (lexically normalised; imports outside the worktree skipped);
  - `find`/`cmp` against `cat-file -p` (never `--filters`/`--textconv`); git calls `--no-ext-diff --no-textconv`; no
    git inside the worktree;
  - a symlink in any path component refuses; `! -type f` refuses before `cmp`; runs under `run-bounded.sh`, and a
    timeout refuses.
  Tests (R5 #3, R6): moved local ref; filter canary never runs; untracked `.mcp.json`; ignored `CLAUDE.local.md`;
  symlinked `.claude`; changed `@`-imported file; uncommitted `CLAUDE.md` and new `.claude/rules/x.md` refuse
  `verify --dry-run` and `deploy --dry-run` naming the file; a FIFO does not hang; a timeout refuses.
  `hooks/ledger-autonomy.sh`
- [ ] T016 [NR-007] **Test-first, R7 must #2 — `accepted_config` binds to the guard's block.** New kind
  `human:config` in KINDS (`ledger.sh:211`); the guard blocks with it, `question_path` listing the differing paths.
  `config-hash <id>` = sha256 over sorted (path, content) pairs + the base sha, called by the launcher and `unblock`.
  `unblock` records `accepted_config` **only** when clearing `human:config`; the guard then passes while the hash
  matches. Tests first: clearing an unrelated `human:intake` on an entry with a changed `CLAUDE.md` records nothing and
  the next verify launch still refuses; after a `human:config` clear the same content passes and one more byte
  refuses. `hooks/ledger.sh`

**Recovery (US2)**

- [ ] T017 [FR-004] [NR-003] `retry <id> --rule verdict|conflict|stall|ci --reason-file <f>` (Sketch 2, R2 #8, R3 #1–2,
  R4 #2, R4 #4): only those classes (`budget`, `human:*` refused naming the rule); must match `blocked_on.kind`;
  per-class budget from the copy; `retry_budget_total` counts implement runs after `.autonomy.first_block_at`; every
  retry sets `attempts = 1`; phase moves verify→implement (verdict), pr→implement (conflict) keeping `.prs[]`,
  `ci` moves pr→verify with no implement run (R7 note); writes `.recovery {rule, evidence, at}` and a decision event;
  a person's `unblock` resets the counters. Tests: budget at its limit refuses naming "n of max"; total ceiling; two
  `retry:verdict` then a real `claim` succeeds with no stall; `next --stage build` returns a retried item; one mutant
  per check. `hooks/ledger-autonomy.sh`
- [ ] T018 [FR-004] The recovery note: the implement prompt (and interactive `--prepare`) carries the last FAIL
  evidence, or "the PR conflicts with <integration>: merge it in and re-run the gates", inside a nonce-delimited data
  block like `rfc_as_data` (R2 #7). Tests: the note appears on a retried entry only; a nonce-forging evidence file
  stays inside the block. `hooks/launch-prompts.sh`

**Merges by policy (US4)**

- [ ] T019 [FR-006] [FR-007] [NR-002] `auto-approve <aid>` on a merge scope (Sketch 3 as revised): one
  `gh pr view --json headRefOid,baseRefName,changedFiles,additions,deletions,files` snapshot; `changedFiles` checked
  against the bound before `files`, lines = additions + deletions; base matched with `is_protected`
  (`ledger.sh:201-206`) against that PR's repo list from the copy; for each `required_gates` entry the latest verdict by
  any author is by `verify-<id>`, PASS, `head ==` snapshot head; snapshot head == `verified_head` == the scope's pinned
  head; refuses when `files` touch `CLAUDE.md`, `**/CLAUDE.md`, `CLAUDE.local.md`, `.mcp.json`, `.claude`/`.claude/**`
  or an `@`-imported file. Writes the store record `by: "policy:auto_merge"`, `policy {name, inputs, inputs_sha256}`,
  `irreversible_confirmed: true`, and a decision event; `try_grant` unchanged. Each refusal names the failing input.
  Tests with a named fake `gh`: one mutant per input (verdict, author, head, base, glob base, size files, size lines,
  sensitive file); unlisted integration branch auto-approved and listed one refused (R2 #1 (d)); a later in-lane FAIL
  at the same head refuses; in-lane-only verdicts refused naming "no launched-verifier verdict".
  `hooks/ledger-autonomy.sh`
- [ ] T020 [FR-008] Remove the second "Irreversible" form from merges: the merge row (`hef.orchestrate.md:139,149-151`)
  and the irreversible-scope rule (`:186-188`) become one form naming what is irreversible. Phrase test: no merge path
  asks "Irreversible: confirm". `commands/hef.orchestrate.md`

**The decision filter (US3)**

- [ ] T021 [FR-005] [NR-004] The decision filter (Sketch 6) in the orchestrator text, the planner prompt
  (`launch-prompts.sh`) and `/hef.clarify` (headless/lane use): resolve from rules, spec, plan, codebase, research;
  take a recommended option and record it with `decide --rule answer:self`; ask only product shape or no best
  practice, the form's question starting "Product:" or "No best practice:". Phrase tests in each of the three files.
  `commands/hef.clarify.md`
- [ ] T022 [FR-004] [FR-006] Orchestrator text: blocks with a recovery go to `retry` (no form) within the budget, and
  to the person with every attempt's evidence once it is spent; the spend-cap refusal follows `cap_fallback` (`lane`:
  ring the open interactive lane; `wait`: say so in the digest), never raising a cap; merges try `auto-approve` first,
  then one form on its refusal (quoting the refused input); after a babysitter push, the item goes back through verify
  before any merge; the name question (`:128`) is removed (FR-010). Phrase tests. `commands/hef.orchestrate.md`

- [ ] T024 [FR-009] A plan stops for the person only when the planner left an open product question: the planner's

- [ ] T025 [FR-012] The digest: `session-start-context.sh` prints `ledger.sh decisions --since <last look>` in the
  orchestrator lane (no form); the status brief includes it. Test: the start context carries one line per decision.

- [ ] T026 [FR-011] [NR-005] **Cut first if the PR grows (R1).** `auto-approve` on a non-merge scope: deny-by-default
